## ScriptureScope contribution

- [ ] I ran the relevant build and validation commands.
- [ ] Any new `datasets/<method>/metadata.json` includes a nonblank `description` explaining what the method represents.
- [ ] Any new method metadata includes a reproducible `calculation` explaining preprocessing, parameters, similarity/link rules, and layout or projection steps.
- [ ] Node IDs are unique, passages are nonblank, coordinates/topic vectors are valid, and every link endpoint matches a node ID.

## Summary

Describe the change and any modeling assumptions or limitations reviewers should know.
